sources.title: GitHub - cangyeone/seismological-ai-tools: Seismology AI Tool
sources.snippet: Seismology AI Tool Introduction This is an open-source tool for seismological data processing and analysis, including phase picking, polarization, and dispersion extraction. We have open-sourced the 100Hz model for the China region, with some models trained on the CSNCD dataset.
